import os
import openpyxl
from datetime import datetime

IN_XLSX = os.environ.get('IN_XLSX')
OUT_XLSX = os.environ.get('OUT_XLSX')
print('IN:', IN_XLSX)
print('OUT:', OUT_XLSX)

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT_XLSX)
ws = wb['Data']

col_to_date = {
    'I': (2015, 6),
    'J': (2015, 7),
    'K': (2015, 8),
    'L': (2015, 9),
    'M': (2015, 10),
    'N': (2015, 11),
    'O': (2015, 12),
    'P': (2016, 1),
    'Q': (2016, 2),
    'R': (2016, 3),
    'S': (2016, 4),
    'T': (2016, 5),
}

cols = ['I','J','K','L','M','N','O','P','Q','R','S','T']

for row in range(9, 19):
    last_date = None
    for col in cols:
        cell = ws[f'{col}{row}']
        val = cell.value
        if val is not None and isinstance(val, (int, float)):
            year, month = col_to_date[col]
            last_date = datetime(year, month, 1)
    if last_date is not None:
        ws[f'U{row}'] = last_date
        ws[f'U{row}'].number_format = 'm/d/yyyy'
    else:
        ws[f'U{row}'] = None

wb.save(OUT_XLSX)
print('Done')
for row in range(9, 19):
    print(f'U{row}: {ws[f"U{row}"].value} format={ws[f"U{row}"].number_format}')
